title: Add IMADreamer to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [IMADreamer](https://fastnow.github.io/imadreamer) to image
- IMADreamer is a free AI image generation tool built on the Pollinations API.

Fixes #11403

gist.headline: Dreams join the garden
gist.blurb: IMADreamer has landed in the app garden: a free image generator built on the Pollinations API. More pixels, fewer permission slips.
gist.summary: Added IMADreamer to the Pollinations app directory, highlighting a free AI image-generation tool built on the Pollinations API.
gist.impact: People can now discover IMADreamer through Pollinations as another free, API-powered way to turn prompts into images.
gist.visual_concept: Depict IMADreamer as a cozy dream-image workshop: Polli helps a small retro monitor bloom vivid imaginary landscape postcards from a prompt-fed code plant. The image generator is represented by a gently glowing CRT and framed pixel artworks, with flowers and vines showing that it belongs in the wider Pollinations app garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm garden workshop where the cute Pollinations bee mascot, with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wears a tiny painter's beret while tending a code-plant that grows dreamy landscape postcards beside a glowing retro CRT labeled "IMADREAMER"; a small monitor robot eagerly holds one generated picture. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel mint-lavender-peach gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, flowers and vines, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
